relationships.subject: CX516
relationships.evidence_quote: However, after local infusions of CX516 into the PL-PFC, rats did not show a preference for either chamber during the testing phase, indicating a decrease in pain aversion

key_findings: CX516 injected into ACC did not reduce pain aversion or modulate ACC neuron nociceptive Ca2+ responses.
CX516 in PL-PFC reduced pain aversion, indicating site-specific AMPAkine effects.
